visible_change: Akademik Kayıt ve Karar → Akış ve saklama: ayrıca kurum kapsamında görevlendirilmiş hazırlayan/ayrı inceleyen/ayrı BT ile kişiye bağlanmamış sona ermiş giriş isteği önizleme ve temizlik; sonuç ve sürümler kalıcı.

new_cases: normal admin/IT cannot infer tenant-wide authority from a unit role
trusted grants require exact next revision, source digest, bounded scope, dates and existing membership
grant write and audit are atomic; no Vercel fallback or out-of-transaction deletion
policy separates preparation, review, execution and reserves one institution-wide chain
only old completed unlinked failed/cancelled rows are selected; academic and security records remain
100-row bound, remaining count, empty rejection and idempotent receipt do not repeat deletion
changed candidates, links, time, policy version and missing confirmation invalidate old preview
preparer revocation/renewal blocks stale review; reviewer grant renewal requires a new policy
current execute grant, original executor, MFA, role, membership and person activity are checked at run/replay
audit failure rolls back all deleted requests, receipt and command; second store cannot reuse stale candidates
grant and policy authority stay tenant/unit bound; no missing-schema mutation or raw request view
real HTTPS failed signed-token callback remains unusable after policy-bound cleanup; current session and barriers survive
real HTTPS cancelled callback remains unusable after policy-bound cleanup; current session and barriers survive
